data.summary: The Franklin X-40 is one of the most-used outdoor pickleballs in the world and the official ball of the US Open. Seamless construction and 40 precision-drilled holes give a consistent bounce and true flight.
data.description:
Built to official USA Pickleball standards, the X-40 weighs 26 g with a 74 mm diameter. Its one-piece, no-seam design is stronger and lasts longer, resisting dents and cracks.

Forty machine-drilled holes keep the flight balanced and the spin tight, so you get the same response rally after rally.

faq.q: Can I use these on our courts?
faq.a: Yes. They are made for outdoor courts like ours.
Yes, USA Pickleball approved for outdoor tournaments.

faq.a: Ask at the front desk for the pack sizes we have in stock.
